arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
echo REA_PREFLIGHT_TARGET=Project-leader-codex
id
printf 'SHELL_HOME=%s\n' "$HOME"
command -v python3
if command -v codex >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo CODEX_CLI_PRESENT; else echo CODEX_CLI_ABSENT_ON_REA_HOST; fi
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-plcodex-cli-diagnostic.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --depth 2 --branch main https://github.com/martaxi-boss/Project-leader-codex.git "$tmp/repo"
cd "$tmp/repo"
printf 'REPO_HEAD='
git rev-parse HEAD
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for p in ['codex/smart.py','codex/dual.py','codex/tests/test_smart.py','codex/tests/test_dual.py']:
 f=Path(p); print('FILE',p,'EXISTS',f.exists())
 if f.exists():
  lines=f.read_text().splitlines()
  for i,line in enumerate(lines):
   if any(s in line for s in ['def _worker(', 'def _private_clone(', 'codex', 'run_directory', 'CODEX_HOME', 'TMPDIR', 'Read-only file system']):
    if ('def ' in line or 'CODEX_HOME' in line or 'TMPDIR' in line or 'subprocess.run(' in line or '["codex"' in line or 'which("codex")' in line or 'Read-only file system' in line):
     print('INSPECT',p,i+1,line[:200])
PY
git diff --check
echo REA_PREFLIGHT_COMPLETE
